Loan & Investment App

I designed a mobile experience bringing loans, investments, everyday banking, insurance and bills into one product. I wanted each money decision to stay understandable even when the app offered several services.

01What I wanted to solve

I worked on the home dashboard, borrowing flow, investment purchase and transaction surfaces. The challenge was showing useful context before someone committed money.

02The decisions that mattered

Give the home screen one clear anchor.

I organised the dashboard around the balance and kept a reveal control for privacy.

Explain the product when the screen is empty.

I used the no-loan state to explain borrowing before offering Request Loan.

Show constraints before the commitment.

I surfaced minimum amounts and wallet balance, and labelled investment projections as estimates with their tax status.

03See the work

The screens below show how those decisions came together.

More screens and supporting work +

04What I can show, and what I would test

The published screens document those decisions. I would test whether people understand a projected maturity value as an estimate, and whether the default balance masking helps them in everyday use.
